messages.author: e71fa8880ffee7d1
messages.subject: NA as case names in 3.7
parts:
Hi everyone,

If you are running QCA 3.7 (not earlier versions), can I ask if you'd be willing to check on an odd effect I'm getting - it might be my installation.

I've attached two files - one an R script, and one a small dataset. 

In 3.6 (on my desktop), this short script produces:

caresolintermediate

n OUT = 1/0/C: 5/5/0 
  Total      : 10 

From C1P1, C1P2: 

Number of multiple-covered cases: 0 

M1:    ADMINCAL*PREVENTCAL*medgoodcal + CURREHABCAL*admincal*longcal*MEDGOODCAL +
       CURREHABCAL*ADMINCAL*longcal*medgoodcal + CURREHABCAL*LONGCAL*PREVENTCAL*medgoodcal +
       admincal*longcal*PREVENTCAL*MEDGOODCAL => CFCARECAL 

                                              inclS   PRI   covS   covU   cases 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
1  ADMINCAL*PREVENTCAL*medgoodcal             0.975  0.942  0.263  0.079  NLD 
2  CURREHABCAL*admincal*longcal*MEDGOODCAL    0.982  0.960  0.352  0.124  AUS 
3  CURREHABCAL*ADMINCAL*longcal*medgoodcal    0.978  0.941  0.285  0.069  USA 
4  CURREHABCAL*LONGCAL*PREVENTCAL*medgoodcal  0.805  0.657  0.224  0.055  UK 
5  admincal*longcal*PREVENTCAL*MEDGOODCAL     0.979  0.946  0.295  0.126  CAN 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
   M1                                         0.934  0.887  0.768

Which I think is correct.

On 3.7 (on my laptop), I get:

caresolintermediate

From C1P1, C1P2:

M1:    ADMINCAL*PREVENTCAL*~MEDGOODCAL +
CURREHABCAL*~ADMINCAL*~LONGCAL*MEDGOODCAL +
       CURREHABCAL*ADMINCAL*~LONGCAL*~MEDGOODCAL +
CURREHABCAL*LONGCAL*PREVENTCAL*~MEDGOODCAL +
       ~ADMINCAL*~LONGCAL*PREVENTCAL*MEDGOODCAL => CFCARECAL

                                               inclS   PRI   covS   covU   cases
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1  ADMINCAL*PREVENTCAL*~MEDGOODCAL             0.975  0.942  0.263  0.079  NA
2  CURREHABCAL*~ADMINCAL*~LONGCAL*MEDGOODCAL   0.982  0.960  0.352  0.124  NA
3  CURREHABCAL*ADMINCAL*~LONGCAL*~MEDGOODCAL   0.978  0.941  0.285  0.069  NA
4  CURREHABCAL*LONGCAL*PREVENTCAL*~MEDGOODCAL  0.805  0.657  0.224  0.055  NA
5  ~ADMINCAL*~LONGCAL*PREVENTCAL*MEDGOODCAL    0.979  0.946  0.295  0.126  NLD
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   M1                                          0.934  0.887  0.768

Which gets the case names all wrong - with NA and NLD appearing on the wrong row.

Can someone please let me know if this works for them in QCA 3.7?

The script is:

library(QCA)
health <- read.csv("healthexample.csv")
rownames(health) <- c("AUS", "CAN", "FRA", "GER", "NLD", "NOR", "SWE", "SWI", "UK", "USA")
ttcare <- truthTable(health, outcome="CFCARECAL", conditions="CURREHABCAL, ADMINCAL, LONGCAL, PREVENTCAL, MEDGOODCAL", incl.cut = 0.8, show.cases = TRUE)
CSAcare <- findRows(obj=ttcare, type=c(2,3))
caresolintermediate <- minimize(ttcare, details=TRUE, include="?", exclude=CSAcare, dir.exp = ("CURREHABCAL*LONGCAL*~ADMINCAL"))
caresolintermediate

Thank you,

Ian

messages.author: 53dbab5845ace6b6
messages.subject: Re: [QCA] NA as case names in 3.7
parts:
Hi Ian,

I confirm replicating your result on my computer, must be something related to excluding those configurations and something I did not manage to catch in all my tests.

Will introduce a patch in the next version,
Adrian
